name: steerline
description: Connects every Claude Code session in an enrolled repository to your team's Steerline: a brief at start, intents and outcomes recorded, questions to the person who owns the decision, decisions in scope.

url.title: Steerline address
url.description: Your company's Steerline, the default is the hosted https://steerline.pigraven.com; set your own address only if you run the platform yourself

token.title: Your Steerline token
token.description: A token from the team page on Steerline; kept in your system's secure credential store
